source.prompt: Which CRMs have a free plan, and what are the limits on it?
source.note: real collected answer; brand, competitors and publishers are the specs the cycle was scored with

answer.text:
Several popular CRMs offer robust "free-forever" plans. While they don't cost anything, every provider enforces specific caps on user seats, contacts, pipelines, or advanced features.
The top free CRM options and their exact limits include:
HubSpot CRM
User Limit:: Unlimited users.
Contact Limit:: 1,000 marketing contacts (with a cap of 1 million total records across standard objects like companies, deals, and tickets).
Key Limits:: Advanced reporting, deeper automated workflows, and complex permissions require paid upgrades.
Check details on the HubSpot CRM Pricing page.
Zoho CRM
User Limit:: Up to 3 users.
Contact Limit:: 5,000 records.
Key Limits:: Limited to 150 emails per day and basic standard reporting. Advanced features like heavy workflow automation or massive integrations are restricted.
Explore the breakdown on Zoho CRM Pricing.
Freshsales (Freshworks)
User Limit:: Up to 3 users.
Contact Limit:: Basic contact and deal management for small teams, but strictly capped on advanced customization.
Key Limits:: Basic contact management, built-in chat/email, and mobile app access, but lacks advanced lifecycle stages and heavy customization.
View specs on the Freshsales Suite Pricing page.
Bitrix24: User Limit: Unlimited users.Storage Limit: 5 GB of online cloud storage.Key Limits: Highly feature-rich (including collaboration and task tools), but customer support on the free tier is community-only, and advanced automation rules are severely restricted.
User Limit:: Unlimited users.
Storage Limit:: 5 GB of online cloud storage.
Key Limits:: Highly feature-rich (including collaboration and task tools), but customer support on the free tier is community-only, and advanced automation rules are severely restricted.
EngageBay: User Limit: Up to 15 users.Contact Limit: 500 contacts and 500 branded emails per month.Key Limits: Very generous user count for a free tier, but tightly capped on total storage and email sending volume.
User Limit:: Up to 15 users.
Contact Limit:: 500 contacts and 500 branded emails per month.
Key Limits:: Very generous user count for a free tier, but tightly capped on total storage and email sending volume.
